description: A civic building has a broad rectangular base supporting a narrower drum and large semicircular dome. A small upper cupola and upright finial crown the dome, while projecting horizontal cornices separate the levels.
A civic building has a central domed block flanked by low rectangular wings. A rounded entrance opens beneath the dome, and a small rectangular flag stands on a pole attached to its summit.
A temple has a large central onion dome flanked by two smaller pointed domes on short towers. A long horizontal cornice spans the facade above a broad central arched doorway.

An Ionic column capital has a wide flat-topped body with curled volutes at both ends. Three long parallel shaft lines descend from its underside, and a short horizontal mark sits between the inward curls.

A mosque-like silhouette has straight lower walls and a flat base beneath a broad pointed onion-shaped top. Small inward shoulders connect the domed upper outline to the otherwise blank rectangular lower body.

A domed government building has a broad lower floor and a narrower upper drum separated by projecting cornices. Three short windows mark the lower floor, one marks the drum, and a finial crowns the dome.
A domed building has a large pointed central cupola topped by an attached crescent. Two slender corner uprights frame the dome above a rectangular wall with a small central arched doorway.
A wide civic building has a central portico with a triangular pediment and arched doorway between lower side wings. Short window marks flank the portico, and a small flag rises from the roof apex.
